sources.content: Change proposal SRW-33: machine-readable output for the Soraway command line tool. Soraway manages DNS zones, and scripts that wrap it currently parse its table output with regular expressions, which break whenever a column is added. This change adds a global --output flag with three values: table, json and yaml. The default stays table, so current users see no change. JSON output follows a schema published at docs/schema/v1.json. YAML output uses the same field names as JSON output.

Limits and rollout. Error messages always go to standard error as plain text, even when --output json is set. The exit code is 0 on success, 1 on a user error and 2 on a server error. Field names in JSON output use snake_case and will not change within schema version 1. The flag ships in Soraway 0.14; the SORAWAY_OUTPUT environment variable sets a default when the flag is absent. Streaming output for long lists is out of scope.

claims.text: Soraway's --output flag accepts table, json and yaml.
Soraway exits with code 1 on a server error.
The SORAWAY_OUTPUT environment variable sets a default output format when --output is absent.
Soraway JSON field names use snake_case.
The default value of Soraway's --output flag becomes json.
Soraway prints error messages to standard error as plain text even with --output json.
